{{Top|leg}}
'''Laser emitters''' were components used in [[Laser welder/Legends|laser welders]]. They could be independently directed for greater control of the laser beam.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[Marksman-H combat remote]] was equipped with laser emitters.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
